title: A door I've never seen
content: I frequent 3 dream worlds. A job world, where I'm perpetually stuck on waitstaff shift either trying to home or get to job, in which phones never work or I can't find my car. A city, full of overpasses and bridges, where I drive around looking for something, someone or I vist said city below. And mall world. These 3 dreams have been constant and consistent in their theams, scenery never has changed or if it dose its a thing I'm aware of in the dream, like it doesn't feel out of place or foreign. Last night a door I have never seen in mall world showed up, I have never seen it down a corridor I walk in the dream. I walk down this way, to go into a shop that I like, I think I have a friend who works there. Anyway, I was making my way, when I come up on a door to my left. A big metal door, and it has a sign on, a red diamond outline, in it reads "WHERE" in plain text. I stop and look at it, then notice that the mall is empty and darker, the hallway looks like it's longer and never-ending. I don't like the way it feels ominous around me, so turn back in the direction I came from, a few steps taken, I trun back to look again and everything, like a camera flash had gone off, is back to normal, people, noises, lighting,, then my alarm sounds. Any idea? Anyone ever have anything like this happen in them their dream worlds?
